The '''Sher Kars''' were the predominant ruling [[Species/Legends|species]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Sher_Kar_attack.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A battle against a Sher Kar]]

They were huge, scorpion-like beasts which mostly inhabited the deepest part of the [[Tulrus Nesting Grounds]], as the [[Tulrus/Legends|Tulrus]] was the Sher Kar's prey of choice. [[Malfosa]] was the most famous Sher Kar, and had killed many people before being killed on the [[Burning Plains/Legends|Burning Plains]]. There were three types of Sher Kar on Mustafar.

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Sher Kar was first mentioned in "Galactic Biological Survey Project – Mustafar," an article posted on the website for the [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing games ]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' on [[September 14]], [[2005]] as part of the pre-release material for the game's [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']] expansion.<ref name="Survey">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?page=Friday%20Feature:%20Trials%20Of%20Obi-Wan%20Creatures&resource=features|text=Galactic Biological Survey Project &ndash; Mustafar}}</ref> The creatures then appeared for the first time in the expansion itself<ref name="Trials">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan]]''</ref> when it was released on [[November 1]], 2005.<ref name="SWGMB">[[Star Wars Galaxies Memory Book|''Star Wars Galaxies'' Memory Book]]</ref>

[[File:Sher-Kar-concept-art.png|thumb|right|300px|The Sher Kar resembled a creature from Episode III concept art.]]
The Sher Kar's appearance<ref name="Trials" /> matches that of a creature depicted in "Mustafar Monster," a piece of concept art created by concept artist [[Sang Jun Lee]] for the<ref name="Concept">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> [[2003]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. The piece was unused in the final film<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> and depicted the monster battling two lightsaber-wielding characters in a volcanic environment on Mustafar, one with a blue blade and one with a [[Sith lightsaber|red blade]].<ref name="Concept" />
